narrowings_added.span: the observation at which its rate of change of heading to the left first rose above the onset yaw rate
narrowings_added.why: The onset is read as the latest observation at which `kin.yaw_rate` of the road user rose definitely above the onset yaw rate (false at the observation before, true there), not the first such rise of the recording: the contract's own words "until a later onset starts the count again" make the count restart at every later onset, so "first rose" is read relative to the judged observation.
